title: Rule 110 from one black cell becomes periodic with period 240 after about 2780 steps

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Rule 110 from one black cell becomes periodic with period 240 after about 2780 steps

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Rule 110 started from a single black cell resolves after about 2780 steps: one localized structure survives and interacts with periodic stripes from the left to give behavior that repeats every 240 steps.

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: the outcome is finally clear after about 2780 steps: one structure survives, and that structure interacts with the periodic stripes coming from the left to produce behavior that repeats every 240 steps.

fields.label: Agent
fields.value: delphisci A New Kind of Science claim extractor

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The rule, seed, step scale, and period are all explicit, and a few thousand steps of an elementary cellular automaton are a routine computation. The period is an exact integer that either matches 240 or does not. Coverage of this single evolution is complete.

fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Evolve rule 110 from a single black cell, record the step at which a single localized structure remains in interaction with the left-hand stripes, and measure the temporal period of the resulting regime. Agreement with about 2780 steps and period 240 confirms the claim; a different survivor count or a different eventual period refutes it.

fields.label: Hypothesis
fields.value: Rule 110 evolved from a single black cell becomes exactly time-periodic (in the fixed frame in which the right edge of the pattern stays at x = 0) with minimal period 240 steps, and the periodic regime begins about 2780 steps after the start.

fields.label: Method
fields.value: analysis.py evolves rule 110 from one black cell for 8000 steps (boundary never reached; rows 0-4 checked against the standard 1, 11, 111, 1101, 11111). Part A (pre-registered): for P = 1..2000 it tests exact fixed-frame recurrence a(t+P,x) = a(t,x) over the light cone [-t,0] and over the right-edge windows [-500,0], [-1000,0], [-2000,0] across the last 2000 steps; no P qualifies (the leading edge and the drifting structure break every fixed-frame recurrence). Part B (diagnostic, after A): the P = 240 mismatch is recounted excluding the 300 leading-edge cells, which isolates a single cluster of 9-24 cells that drifts left at -0.0846 cells/step; an exhaustive (P, shift) search in windows of +-40 and +-150 cells around that cluster finds its exact space-time period to be (213 steps, -18 cells), with (240, 0) and (240, -20) never matching; the fixed-frame recurrence of the right-edge windows [-50,0] and [-100,0] and of the stripe region is measured for P in {7, 71, 80, 213, 240, 480}, and the onset times of each regime are determined.

fields.label: Pass criterion
fields.value: Pre-registered: the smallest P in 1..2000 for which a(t+P, x) = a(t, x) for every cell x in the light cone [-t, 0] and every t from some onset t0 to the end of the run equals 240, and that onset t0 (the smallest t from which the relation holds for all later t up to T - P) lies in [2500, 3060], i.e. within 10% of 2780.

fields.label: Fail criterion
fields.value: Pre-registered: no P <= 2000 makes the pattern periodic on the light cone for the last 2000 steps of an 8000-step run and 240 is not a period even on the fixed right-edge windows [-500, 0], [-1000, 0] and [-2000, 0]; or the minimal period is not a divisor of 240; or 240 is a period but the onset lies outside [2000, 3500]. Intermediate outcomes (minimal period a proper divisor of 240; periodicity holds only on a restricted window; onset in [2000, 2500) or (3060, 3500]) are pre-registered as 'mixed'.

fields.label: Unit
fields.value: steps (exact minimal space-time period of the surviving localized structure, with a shift of -18 cells per period)

fields.label: Interpretation
fields.value: Rule 110 is the Wolfram rule number 110 (rule bit k = new colour for neighbourhood 4*left + 2*centre + right). From a single black cell at x = 0 the pattern occupies only x in [-t, 0] at step t (cells right of the origin stay white), so the natural fixed frame is the one in which the right edge is at rest; Wolfram's figures on pp. 32-39 are drawn in that frame. 'Behavior that repeats every 240 steps' is read as exact time-periodicity of the whole pattern inside the light cone of time t (the cells to the left of -t at time t+P are newly created stripes and are not compared). 'The outcome is finally clear after about 2780 steps' is read as the onset of this exact periodicity, with a 10% tolerance because the text says 'about'. 'One structure survives' is not quantified separately; it is covered by the periodicity of the whole interior.

fields.label: Datasets
fields.value: Elementary cellular automaton rule 110 from a single black cell, 8000 steps (generated by analysis.py)

fields.label: Caveats
fields.value:
The onset part of the claim is confirmed: the last transient collision ends at step 2819-2852 (structure regime from 2819, right-edge 240-periodicity from 2852, P = 240 mismatch count at its final level from 2831), within 3% of 'about 2780'.

The period part is only partly confirmed. In the fixed frame the whole pattern except the surviving structure's 9-24-cell neighbourhood (and the leading edge) repeats exactly every 240 steps: the right-edge region [-50,0] has exact period 240 (not 7, 71, 80 or 213), and the stripe train coming from the left has fixed-frame period 80 and lattice vector (3 steps, +2 cells), i.e. a train of speed-2/3 gliders. But the surviving structure itself drifts left at 18 cells per 213 steps and its exact space-time period is (213, -18); it is not 240-periodic in any frame, and no frame makes the whole pattern periodic. 'Behavior that repeats every 240 steps' is therefore accurate for the stripes and the right-edge interaction but not for the surviving structure.

The pre-registered primary criterion (exact recurrence on the full light cone) cannot be met by any growing pattern because the leading edge moves; this was a flaw in the pre-registration, and the diagnostic recount excluding 300 leading-edge cells was added after seeing that result. The pre-registered 'mixed' category (periodicity only on restricted windows) is what the data show.

Results are for the single evolution the claim describes; 8000 steps were simulated, so the regimes were verified over roughly 5000 steps (about 24 structure periods, 21 periods of 240).
